title: 50/50 love/hate
text: The subscription comes with two tonies at the same price if you buy them individually. No discount with subscription. Given tonies has started releasing multiple tonies vs a few like when they started out, I personally  find it better to just buy individual of what I need vs waiting on the two surprise tonies in a subscription. If these were harder to come by the subscription it may be worth it. But if you follow tonies, you’ll know who and when is dropping and just be there day of release and buy what you need. Also, If the subscription had a discount and option to pick two for the subscription, then this would work for me and I’d get onboard. But as of now, not worth it.
label: neutral
